entries.wording: 樂達全球速遞 已攬收
entries.note: Leda takes the parcel in at Hong Kong. The row opens with 【中国香港】, which becomes the location.

entries.wording: 貨物到達樂達全球速遞香港倉

entries.note: Left the Hong Kong warehouse for Shenzhen.

entries.wording: 货物到达海关，等待清关
entries.note: At customs in Shenzhen, waiting for clearance. The row opens with 【中国深圳】.

entries.wording: 海关已放行。待交付当地承运方（顺丰：SF…）。
entries.note: Released by customs, waiting for the courier in China, named with its waybill. Any courier and number.

entries.wording: 顺丰速运 已收取快件，您的期待，我们定竭诚守护，不负所托。
entries.note: SF Express takes the parcel from Leda, mid-journey for the parcel. SF's rows follow in Chinese, each opening with its city in [], which becomes the location.

entries.wording: 快件在【…】完成分拣，准备发往 【…】
entries.note: SF's depots and service points fill the 【】, as in the rows below.

entries.wording: 快件离开 【…】，已在发往 【…】 的路上

entries.note: A service point's brackets can hold its street address after its name.

entries.wording: 快件开始长途运输，两站距离…KM
entries.note: A truck leaves on a long haul, with the distance between the two depots.

entries.wording: 车辆正在长途运输中，车辆临近【…】，请您放心
entries.note: The truck is near the city named; some rows add the distance left to the next depot. The rows open with no city.

entries.wording: 快件交给【…，联系电话：…】，正在派送途中（…）
entries.note: On a delivery round with the courier, named with their phone, as SF words it.

entries.wording: 快件已交接给顺丰合作点(…，联系电话：…，地址：…），请凭取货信息前往合作点领取您的快递。
entries.note: Left at an SF partner point, named with its phone and address, for the recipient to collect; the shared wording rules read it.

entries.wording: 您的快件已派送至本人，如有疑问请电联快递员【…，电话：…】。…
entries.note: Delivered to the recipient in person, at the same minute as the collection, naming the courier with their phone.
